page.overview:
Who is Devil King of Great Strength?

The is a soldier in the army of Li Jing.

The Devil King of Great Strength was sent alongside Prince Muzha to request reinforcements from the Jade Emperor, and then was tasked with delivering the summons to Erlang Shen.
